Scrubber (Neo Scrubber) is an EDI 837P claims scrubber. Organizations upload professional claim files, the platform parses and validates them against structural and business rules, and users review batch/claim results in a web UI.

Scrubber handles healthcare claims EDI. Treat uploads and claim fields as sensitive: Never commit real EDI containing PHI Never log passwords, tokens, or full sensitive payloads Docs and tests use synthetic samples only Compliance Do not claim HIPAA certification solely because the app handles healthcare data. Any compliance statement needs explicit authoritative evidence and approval.
